manual_formula_check: For standard normal Z and z_t=(ln(t)-mu)/sigma, conditional quantile z_a satisfies Phi(-z_a)=(1-a)Phi(-z_t); ndtri_exp(logsf+log1p(-a)) returns -z_a, so mu-sigma*that gives the correct log-EOL quantile. Horizon risk is -expm1(logS(t+h)-logS(t)).
